explanation: Built and verified the Rust OrderDesk application end-to-end from the sealed bundle using riffdb new, riffdb application lock --write, and riffdb dev --seed --run with zero handwritten glue lines. Contract arithmetic updates across separate entity bindings required an explicit checked_by RequirementName clause, money<USD> in contract commands failed MCP surface generation and was replaced with decimal<12,2>, and seed JSONL decimal fields required explicit tagged decimal objects while the Rust SDK Decimal newtype accepted string literals directly.
